title: Has high hopes
text: Has high hopes. It's bought and placed it in 2 entry points in mid April when the ants scouts for food. I'm near the Boston area and only have pavement ants that are coming from a crawl space into my bathroom. I've read that this has the diffeo types food in one, carbs, protein, fats depending on what the colony needs at any particular time. I've mostly used Terro but they drown themselves in it constantly. Go away for 2 days and come back for more drowning and then they just walk around it. So after they disappear for 2 days, I placed a drop, afew ants smell it, back away from it and look for something else. I think they can smell the poison. Some might eat it for 2 bites and walk away. The rest will just walk away from it uninterested. I guess I'll go back to the Terro for the slow drowning and wasteful product for the drowning bodies. Sometimes I can't tell if they are trying to recover the dead ones and drown themselves during. No other option. No point in placing anything in the crawl space if they aren't eating this to give to the queen.
